## Checks
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run harness` passes (needed when `src/content.js`, `src/background.js` or `src/core.js` changed)
- [ ] No new permissions, sites or network requests (see `store/PRIVACY.md`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated; version bumped in `manifest.json` and `package.json` together if this is a release
